== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Valetudo Rubor]] ([[Hell's Precipice]])
* [[Staggh the Fervid]] ([[Dragon's Gullet]], only during [[The Titan Source]])

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Conflagration}}

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Greater Conflagration]].
* Synergizes with skills/items that are contingent on fire damage: [[Mark of Rodgort]], [[Conjure Flame]], [[Pyrebound Insignia]], [[Mantra of Flame]], and others.
** It is especially useful to counter certain enemy skills, e.g. [[Glint|Glint's]] [[Jagged Crystal Skin]] is rendered useless in [[The Dragon's Lair]]. 
** Combine with [[Winter]] to take advantage of cold-based contingencies, e.g. [[Mantra of Frost]].

{{anomaly|Unlike [[Winter]] this skill requires the ''attacker'' to be inside the spirit [[area of effect]].}}

{{bug|Does not properly convert the physical damage of certain skills (notably: [[Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support]] and [[Veil of Thorns]]). As a result, the skill chain will not trigger the conditional effects of other skills that depend on fire damage (in particular, for [[Intensity]]).}}

== Trivia ==
* This skill was not an elite during beta testing of the game.
* This is one of nine elite skills seen in [[pre-Searing Ascalon]] in {{reforgedmode}}, where it is used by [[Charr Stalker Lord]]s. The other eight are [[Barrage]], [[Bull's Charge]], [[Earth Shaker]], [[Elemental Attunement]], [[Hundred Blades]], [[Plague Signet]], [["Victory Is Mine!"]], and [[Ward Against Harm]].
